title: Benchmark Cobalt & Nickel Market Update
gist: Member-only Benchmark Week 2026 video page for Benchmark COO Caspar Rawles' joint cobalt and nickel market update (Nov 10, 2026). No transcript; the agenda says it covers Class 1 nickel supply, Indonesian HPAL growth and cobalt dynamics in the DRC.

insights.claim: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence's joint cobalt and nickel market update focuses on three supply topics: Class 1 nickel supply, Indonesian HPAL growth, and cobalt dynamics in the DRC.
insights.speaker: Caspar Rawles, COO, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Indonesian HPAL and the DRC are named as the key swing factors for battery-grade nickel and cobalt supply.
insights.quote: Class 1 nickel supply, Indonesian HPAL growth and cobalt dynamics in the DRC

insights.claim: Benchmark highlights Indonesian HPAL growth as a key nickel market topic. HPAL is a route that adds nickel, and cobalt by-product, supply from Indonesia.
insights.speaker: Caspar Rawles, COO, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: Growing Indonesian HPAL output adds battery-grade nickel and cobalt supply, which is relevant to price outlooks and non-Indonesian project economics.

insights.claim: Caspar Rawles' cobalt and nickel update at Benchmark Week 2026 is member-only, and the page gives no prices or balances.
insights.speaker: Caspar Rawles, COO, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
insights.so_what: The quantitative cobalt and nickel outlook is behind the paywall.

source_meta.author: Caspar Rawles, COO, Benchmark Mineral Intelligence
